articles.title: England vs. France: Why the Third-Place Match Is Still a Big Deal
articles.summary: England's World Cup dream ended, but Saturday's third-place game against France could decide the Golden Boot. Kylian Mbappe is tied with Lionel Messi at 8 goals—one more could make him top scorer!

articles.title: President Trump Talks About the 2020 Election—Here's What You Need to Know
articles.summary: President Trump is giving a speech about the 2020 election, focusing on claims of foreign interference. But experts say the election was secure, and no foreign power changed any votes.

articles.title: Argentina's World Cup Celebration Sparks Falklands Dispute with UK
articles.summary: After beating England, Argentina's players held a banner saying 'The Falklands are Argentine.' The UK government fired back, saying the islands are British and the people there want to stay that way.
